decisions.reason: As a certified plate heat exchanger line very close to the core business, it likely remains above or near aspiration through fit with existing engineering, sales, and service capabilities, so we would retain it despite limited recent visibility.
Its earlier signal of major market share in marine water cooling puts it comfortably above aspiration, making continuation the clearly preferred choice.

The compact oil cooler still fits the established exchanger portfolio and can be carried with modest incremental burden, so with industry growth and organisational slack we would continue it unless clearer underperformance emerges.

Finned tubes are more component-like and less central to the firm’s integrated solution-and-service focus, and after several years without clear positive signals the product is more likely to fall below aspiration and have its resources shifted elsewhere.

Enhanced tubes support the firm’s R&D-led improvement path and can feed learning into the broader exchanger portfolio, so even with some uncertainty we would keep them for now rather than cut them immediately.
